claims.claim: Plastic drum for storage of any kind of Liquid
claims.evidence: Witness photos show blue cylindrical metal tanks/drums with bolted/flanged end caps and central ports, not plastic.

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water.
claims.evidence: No readable food-grade markings/certification or water-only usage proof shown in the witness report.

claims.claim: No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: Photos show scuffs, dents/scratches, and rust/oxidation spots; leak/crack status and lid/port integrity cannot be confirmed from the provided images.

risks.risk: Wrong item type/material (seller says plastic; witness shows metal cylinders/tanks). This affects safety, compatibility, and resale value.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the full tank showing material (metal thickness/markings) plus any label/plate stating type and intended contents.
risks.if_unproven: Price as industrial metal cylinders with unknown contents and condition (worst-case for buyer risk).

risks.risk: Unknown contents/chemical residue inside (could be hazardous even if 'water').
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of any internal inspection/cleaning certificate or a statement of last contents plus a close-up of any label/markings on the tank ends.
risks.if_unproven: Price as contaminated/unknown-use tanks requiring cleaning/handling.

risks.risk: Structural integrity compromised by dents/scratches and visible oxidation around seams/edges.
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of dents and seam areas plus a video showing the tank from multiple angles; ideally include a pressure test/inspection report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as damaged/possibly non-ideal integrity (discounted for risk).

risks.risk: Valve/port condition unknown (central opening/port shown, but no confirmation of valve, cap, or sealing surfaces).
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the central port/valve area and the exact lid/cap/cover that seals it, including threads/seat condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing/uncertain sealing components (buyer must source parts).

risks.risk: Pressure rating and safety certification unknown (critical for gas/liquid tanks).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the rating plate/label showing pressure rating, contents type, and any certification/inspection dates.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unverified/uncertified tanks (worst-case for compliance and transport).

risks.risk: Transport readiness unknown (empty/clean status, included accessories like regulators/hoses not shown).
risks.proof: Ask for photos showing whether tanks are empty/clean and what accessories are included (valves/caps/regulators/hoses).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed ready for immediate use (buyer may need cleaning and parts).

proof_requests: Clear photos of any label/plate on each tank showing contents type and pressure rating (or storage rating).
Close-up photos of the central port/valve area and the exact lid/cap that seals it (threads/seat condition).
Photos/videos of the dents and seam/oxidation areas from multiple angles.
Any inspection/testing or certification documents (or at least inspection date stamps).
Photos showing whether tanks are empty and clean, and what accessories are included (if any).
response.reason: The witness report identifies metal industrial cylinders/tanks with visible wear and unknown ratings/contents, while the seller claims plastic food-grade water storage. Without proof of material confirmation, contents history, sealing/valve condition, and any rating/certification, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
